description: This file defines the `PredefinedShelfService` class, which manages predefined bookshelves for users in the book project. It includes methods for creating, finding, and managing shelves and the books within them, as well as populating test data during application initialization.

classes.name: PredefinedShelfService
classes.description: Service class responsible for managing predefined bookshelves associated with users, including creation, retrieval, population with test data, and management of books within these shelves.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Finds a PredefinedShelf by its unique ID.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a PredefinedShelf to the repository.

methods.name: findAllForLoggedInUser
methods.description: Retrieves all predefined shelves for the currently logged-in user.

methods.name: findToReadShelf
methods.description: Finds the 'To Read' shelf for the current user.

methods.name: findReadingShelf
methods.description: Finds the 'Reading' shelf for the current user.

methods.name: findReadShelf
methods.description: Finds the 'Read' shelf for the current user.

methods.name: findDidNotFinishShelf
methods.description: Finds the 'Did Not Finish' shelf for the current user.

methods.name: findByPredefinedShelfNameAndLoggedInUser
methods.description: Retrieves a predefined shelf for the current user by shelf name.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the total number of predefined shelves.

methods.name: populateTestData
methods.description: Populates the database with test data, including authors, tags, publishers, shelves, and books, typically run after startup.

methods.name: populateAuthorRepository
methods.description: Populates author repository with test authors.

methods.name: populateTagRepository
methods.description: Populates tag repository with test tags.

methods.name: populatePublisherRepository
methods.description: Populates publisher repository with test publishers.

methods.name: populateShelfRepository
methods.description: Creates and saves predefined shelves for a given user.

methods.name: populateBookRepository
methods.description: Creates and saves books associated with predefined shelves and other related entities.

methods.name: setShelfForEveryBookInBookRepository
methods.description: Assigns predefined shelves to all books in the repository.

methods.name: createPredefinedShelves
methods.description: Creates a list of predefined shelf objects for a user.

methods.name: getPredefinedShelfByNameAsString
methods.description: Returns a predefined shelf object given its name as a string, for the logged-in user.

methods.name: getPredefinedShelfByPredefinedShelfName
methods.description: Returns a predefined shelf object given its enum name, for the logged-in user.

methods.name: getBooksInChosenPredefinedShelf
methods.description: Retrieves books in a specified shelf or all shelves if 'All books' is specified.

methods.name: isAllBooksShelf
methods.description: Checks if the provided shelf name string corresponds to the 'All books' shelf.

methods.name: getBooksInAllPredefinedShelves
methods.description: Retrieves all books across all predefined shelves for the logged-in user.

methods.name: deleteAll
methods.description: Deletes all predefined shelves from the repository.

methods.name: getBooksInPredefinedShelves
methods.description: Static method to collect books from a list of predefined shelves.

methods.name: isPredefinedShelf
methods.description: Checks if a string matches any predefined shelf name.

methods.name: getPredefinedShelfName
methods.description: Converts a string to an Optional of the matching ShelfName enum, if any.
